name: Grove
avoid_for: Decks that need neon energy or rapid-fire pop — the forest-green canvas and Playfair serif commit to a slow, classical voice
weak_cases: Light small text and air-dependent composition are weak for projected dense material.
visual_signature: Light Playfair/Jost typography, rare terracotta italic emphasis and watermark numerals.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Italic and light Latin typography cannot be assumed equivalent in other scripts; adapt weight and emphasis.

assets.images: Optional quiet editorial image; sparse type-led pages do not require one.
